FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 155
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Laura Hall
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/13/2023
House Bill 155 as introduced would appropriate $169,633 from the State General Fund to the
Coalition Against Domestic Violence for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2024.
